title: Ships and Giggles
meta_description: Ships and Giggles is a luxury 4-bedroom 30A vacation rental in Blue Mountain Beach, Florida, featuring a 6-seater street-legal golf cart, resort-style lagoon community pool and hot tub, and accommodations for up to 12 guests. Located in desirable Highland Parks along Scenic Highway 30A, this family-friendly Santa Rosa Beach vacation home is convenient to Blue Mountain Beach
description_expanded: AboutShips and Giggles | Luxury 30A Vacation Rental with 6-Seater Golf Cart, and Resort Community Pool and Hot Tub Blue Mountain Beach, Florida | Sleeps 12 | 4 Bedrooms | 3.5 Bathrooms | 6-Seater Street-Legal Golf Cart | Resort-Style Community Pool and Hot Tub | Scenic Highway 30A Welcome to Ships and Giggles, a luxury 30A vacation rental in Blue Mountain Beach, Florida, offering the perfect combination of location, resort-style amenities, and family-friendly coastal living. Located in the sought-after Highland Parks community along Scenic Highway 30A, this spacious four-bedroom beach home sleeps up to 12 guests and includes a 6-seater street-legal golf cart, beach gear, and access to a spectacular lagoon-style community pool and hot tub. Spend your mornings along the sugar-white beaches of the Gulf, enjoy the scenic 30A trail, cruise through Blue Mountain Beach in the golf cart, or relax beside the Highland Parks resort pool. Popular restaurants, ice cream, shopping, Gulf Place, Grayton Beach, and other favorite 30A destinations are all within easy reach. Inside, approximately 2,330 square feet of beautifully designed living space provides plenty of room for families and friends, with vaulted ceilings, an open-concept floor plan, a fully stocked kitchen, four comfortable bedrooms, and two private ensuite bedrooms. Thoughtful amenities for both adults and children make Ships and Giggles an ideal choice for a family vacation, multi-generational getaway, or group trip to 30A. Home Highlights • 6-seater street-legal golf cart included • Prime Blue Mountain Beach location on Scenic Highway 30A • Sleeps up to 12 guests • 4 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms • 2 private ensuite bedrooms • Approximately 2,330 square feet of two-story living space • Located in the desirable Highland Parks at Blue Mountain Beach community • Large resort-style lagoon community pool • Community hot tub • Cascading waterfalls, expansive sun deck, grilling area, and gathering spaces • 4 backpack beach chairs and 1 beach umbrella • Open-concept living, dining, and kitchen areas • Vaulted ceilings and inviting coastal interiors • Fully stocked kitchen with spices provided • 2 cribs, 1 Pack 'n Play, 1 high chair, and children's dishes • Scenic walking and biking paths • Convenient access to Blue Mountain Beach Regional Beach Access • Close to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery and Red Fish Taco • Minutes from Gulf Place, Grayton Beach, Dune Allen Beach, and Seaside • Convenient to restaurants, boutique shopping, coffee shops, and entertainment Experience Blue Mountain Beach and Scenic Highway 30A Ships and Giggles places you in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach, one of South Walton's most loved communities along Scenic Highway 30A. Known for its relaxed coastal atmosphere, beautiful beaches, rare coastal dune lakes, locally owned restaurants, and scenic walking trails, this area offers an authentic 30A experience with plenty to explore. Start the morning with a stroll along the Timpoochee Trail, head toward Blue Mountain Beach Regional Beach Access for a day along the Gulf, grab ice cream at Blue Mountain Beach Creamery, or enjoy tacos and live music at Red Fish Taco. The home's central location also makes exploring neighboring 30A communities easy. Visit Gulf Place and Dune Allen Beach to the west or head east toward Grayton Beach and Seaside for restaurants, boutiques, entertainment, and some of the area's most iconic coastal scenery. Resort-Style Living at Highland Parks When you're ready for a break from the beach, Highland Parks offers an impressive lagoon-style community swimming pool surrounded by amenities designed for relaxing and spending time together. Cool off beneath cascading waterfalls, soak in the hot tub, lounge on the spacious sun deck, or enjoy the outdoor grilling and gathering areas. The resort-style setting gives guests another way to enjoy a beautiful Florida day without leaving the neighborhood. Spacious Coastal Living Designed with families and groups in mind, Ships and Giggles offers approximately 2,330 square feet across two stories, providing plenty of space to gather while still allowing guests room to relax. The bright, open-concept living room, dining area, and kitchen create the heart of the home. Vaulted ceilings enhance the spacious feel, while comfortable furnishings and coastal-inspired interiors provide an inviting place to unwind after a day at the beach. Four bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms comfortably accommodate up to 12 guests, while two private ensuite bedrooms provide additional privacy for couples, parents, and multi-generational families. Gather, Dine and Relax The fully stocked kitchen makes everything from quick beach-day breakfasts to family dinners easy, with cookware, dinnerware, glassware, utensils, and spices provided. Because the kitchen flows directly into the dining and living areas, everyone can stay connected whether you're preparing dinner, playing games, planning the next day's adventures, or simply enjoying an evening at home. Explore 30A by Golf Cart Leave the car behind and embrace the laid-back 30A lifestyle. Cruise through Blue Mountain Beach in the included 6-seater street-legal golf cart, hike the scenic trail, spend the day along the Gulf, or head out for dinner, shopping, ice cream, and live music. With beach gear waiting at the home and some of 30A's most popular communities nearby, Ships and Giggles makes it easy to get out and experience the best of Blue Mountain Beach, Santa Rosa Beach, and Scenic Highway 30A. Your 30A Vacation Starts at Ships and Giggles Spend mornings along the Gulf, afternoons beside the Highland Parks lagoon-style pool, and evenings exploring the restaurants and coastal communities of Scenic Highway 30A. With an exceptional Blue Mountain Beach location and thoughtful amenities for adults and children alike, Ships and Giggles gives families and friends a comfortable home base for experiencing everything they came to 30A to enjoy. Book Ships and Giggles and start planning your Blue Mountain Beach getaway on Florida's beautiful Emerald Coast.
